BiblicalUsage: Moba is an entrance, a coming in — Abner came to deceive, to know thy going out and thy coming in, and the prophet is told to show the house to Israel, its going out and its coming in, that they may be ashamed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God watches the doorways: He knows my going out and my coming in, and the shame of it is meant to turn me back.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
